name: r134a_water_cooled_condenser
title: R134a refrigerator with a water-cooled condenser (Cengel 11-11)
summary: R134a vapour-compression cycle with a water-cooled condenser. Point 1 is 60 kPa and -34 °C, point 2 is 1.2 MPa and 65 °C, and point 3 is 42 °C. Cooling water goes from 18 °C to 26 °C at 0.25 kg/s. The model computes the condenser heat, the refrigerant flow, the compressor power and the refrigerator COP. Textbook exercise Cengel 11-11.

verification.summary: Against the stored solution of 11-11d.EES. compare_solution.py: 29 common variables, 10 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 0. Maximum relative difference 6.63e-01 on s_3 (R134a entropy offset). COP 2.15050 vs 2.15050; condenser heat 8365.89 W vs 8366.08 W; water flow 0.25 kg/s both sides.
verification.reference: EES stored solution in 11-11d.EES (29 variables, EES X9.920)
verification.notes: 29 common variables. The tool prints a maximum relative difference of 6.63e-01 on s_3; the exact ratio is 0.6633360234. The ten variables above rtol=0.001 are h_1 (3.92e-01), h_2 (3.34e-01), h_3 (5.71e-01), h_4 (5.71e-01), s_1 (4.50e-01), s_2 (4.49e-01), s_3 (6.63e-01), s_4 (6.28e-01), DELTAT_sh_1 (4.40e-03) and DELTAT_sc_3 (4.77e-03). Saturated liquid R134a at -40 °C in this binary is h = 148144.046 J/kg and s = 795.610 J/kg-K, where EES sets h = s = 0. CoolSolve minus EES is 148144.99 to 148146.83 J/kg on the four enthalpies and 795.61386 to 795.61999 J/kg-K on the four entropies. After subtracting that reference, the residuals are 0.95 to 2.78 J/kg and 0.003 to 0.009 J/kg-K. DELTAT_sh_1 and DELTAT_sc_3 differ because T_sat differs by 0.013 °C at 60 kPa and 0.021 °C at 1.2 MPa. Water enthalpies differ by +75.3 J/kg (h_w_in, rel 9.96e-04) and +74.5 J/kg (h_w_out, rel 6.83e-04), both under rtol. COP relative difference 2.98e-06; Q_dot_h 2.31e-05; M_dot 3.31e-05; M_dot_w 0. Stored unit strings are blank and the stored enthalpies are already in J, so compare_solution.py was run without --ees-units. 4 iterations with the shipped .initials, 8 without. No abs() and no second root. No diagram-state arrays were added.
